questions.questionText:
Increasing output of one good reduces production of another good.
Which economic concept does this change represent?

options.text: average cost
diseconomies of scale
economies of scale
opportunity cost

questions.questionText: What condition in an economy would encourage immigration of labour?

options.text: high cost of housing
preference for domestic over foreign qualifications
reduced quotas for foreign workers
shortage of skilled workers

questions.questionText: Who is a microeconomic decision maker?

options.text: the director of an international trade organisation
the entrepreneur of a firm
the finance minister of a government
the governor of a central bank

questions.questionText: What is an essential feature of a market economy?

options.text: Central planners determine what, how and for whom to produce.
It aims for equality in the distribution of goods and services.
The market price reflects both the private and external costs of production.
The price mechanism sends signals to consumers and producers to allocate resources.

questions.questionText:
138
Which statement about the country is correct?

options.text: It faced deflation in year 2.
It faced deflation in year 3.
It faced inflation in year 4.
It faced inflation in year 5.

questions.questionText: What is a definition of market failure?

options.text: market forces of demand and supply do not allocate resources efficiently
not all consumers can afford to buy the goods they would like
private benefits of consumption are greater than external benefits
public goods are only provided by a government

questions.questionText:
Average incomes rose by 5% but savings did not rise.
What might explain this?

options.text: Consumer confidence in the economy fell.
Incomes rose more slowly than the rate of inflation.
Interest rates for savings rose.
The rate of income tax was reduced.

questions.questionText: Which firm is in the tertiary sector?

options.text: bread bakery
fruit grower
meal delivery
road builder

questions.questionText: What is a benefit to a worker of being a member of a trade union?

options.text: access to advice
guaranteed employment
opportunity to work extra hours
payment of subscriptions

questions.questionText: How would advertising a good result in a retail firm increasing its market share?

options.text: It will improve the personal service in its shops.
It will increase the firm’s costs.
It will reduce demand for competitors’ products.
It will result in diversification in the firm.

questions.questionText: What describes the total revenue of a firm?

options.text: fixed costs plus variable costs
income from sales minus total costs
quantity of goods sold multiplied by unit price
variable costs divided by output

questions.questionText: What is fiscal policy?

options.text: government decisions on money supply and interest rates taken to influence total demand
government decisions on spending and taxation designed to influence total demand
government measures designed to influence total supply in the economy
government regulation of the foreign exchange rate to influence imports

questions.questionText: What is the money supply?

options.text: the total quantity of foreign currency available within the economy
the total quantity of money available within the economy
the total quantity of money issued by the central bank
the total quantity of money within commercial banks

questions.questionText: What may cause deflation?

options.text: advances in technology and increases in labour productivity
government using a policy of very low interest rates
increases in the costs of production that reduce firms’ profits
increases in the rate of inflation as measured by the CPI

questions.questionText: Economic growth can be defined as

options.text: a reduction in a country’s rate of inflation.
an increase in a country’s exports.
an increase in a country’s population.
an increase in a country’s productive capacity.

questions.questionText:
In a year, two changes occurred in a company.
Company directors’ salaries increased by 15%.
Office workers’ wages increased by 5%.
The rate of inflation was 3.4%.
What happened to real income?
company directors’ office workers’
real income real income

options.text: fell fell
fell rose
rose fell
rose rose

questions.questionText:
The richest 60% of the population of a high-income economy received an increase in income.
The income of the rest of the population did not change.
What happened to absolute and relative poverty?
absolute poverty relative poverty

options.text: increased increased
increased remained constant
remained constant increased
remained constant remained constant

questions.questionText:
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a better measure of comparative living standards when it is
adjusted for the effects of

options.text: exports and inflation.
imports and exports.
population change and exports.
population change and inflation.

questions.questionText: What is a benefit of a multinational company (MNC) to the host country?

options.text: A MNC may improve the reputation of its home country as a high-quality producer.
Exports by a MNC may result in an improved trade balance for the host country.
Production by a MNC may lead to higher levels of pollution in the host country.
Profits made by a MNC are sent back to its home country.

questions.questionText:
Globalisation is the process by which domestic firms become involved in international markets.
What encourages globalisation?

options.text: controls on foreign exchange
immigration restrictions
increasing tariffs
widespread use of the internet

questions.questionText: What does a foreign exchange rate between Malaysia and the US measure?

options.text: the cost of the Malaysian currency in the US currency
the difference in the cost of living between Malaysia and the US
the difference in the standard of living between Malaysia and the US
GDP of Malaysia divided by the GDP of the US

questions.questionText:
A country has a deficit on its current account of its balance of payments.
What could increase the size of its deficit?

options.text: increased exports of its services
increased international competitiveness of its goods
increased numbers of visitors from abroad
